description: Bulk web evidence gatherer. Give it ONE specific question plus (optionally) a URL, and it searches/fetches and returns the exact passages that bear on it — each with its source URL and a verbatim quote. It never judges, concludes, or recommends: it reports what the sources say and, when they say nothing, reports that. Call it once per question. Use it whenever you need to READ the web: it absorbs the pages into its own cheap context so yours stays small.
name: web_fetcher
